voiceNote: Kokoro af_bella (Coach Bella), generated by the lead

chapters.label: Live: the 2012 final
chapters.text: The 2012 Futsal World Cup final. Extra time, two all, nineteen seconds left! Neto, Brazil’s last defender, flicks it over his man, races down the wing, and shoots low with his left foot. Far corner!

chapters.label: Replay: over the tackle
chapters.text: Watch again. He lifts it over the tackle, and he’s away! Three two. Brazil are world champions!

chapters.label: How he defends
chapters.text: This is how he defends: when his team loses the ball, he sprints back, gets between the ball and the goal, and stops it.

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn! When your team loses the ball, always get back behind it.
